business_problem: Spotify wanted to scale its advertising business across far more markets and make digital-audio advertising easier for brands to buy, create, measure, and optimize, but campaign operations and creative workflows needed to move faster to support that growth.
solution_summary: Spotify and Accenture combined workflow automation, ad-tech operations, and generative AI tools to expand the company's advertising engine. Accenture has supported Spotify advertising operations since 2018, helping scale the business from 20 to more than 150 ad markets while automating campaign-launch workflows so advertisers can get to market faster. Spotify's ad stack includes channels such as Spotify Ads Exchange and Ads Manager, and the newer layer of gen-AI-powered audio production tools makes it easier for advertisers to create scalable, lower-cost ad assets. On the analytics side, Accenture is also helping build Insights Studio, a dashboarding and reporting service that gives sales teams better market and campaign intelligence. The overall flow now links campaign creation, trafficking, measurement, and optimization more tightly so Spotify can move ads into market faster, support more advertisers, and improve ROI visibility for brands using the platform.

solution_components.name: Spotify Ads Exchange
solution_components.role: Provides one of the buying channels through which advertisers place digital-audio campaigns on Spotify.

solution_components.name: Ads Manager
solution_components.role: Supports advertiser self-service campaign creation and management across Spotify's ad inventory.

solution_components.name: gen-AI-powered audio production tools
solution_components.role: Help advertisers create high-quality audio ads quickly and at lower cost.

solution_components.name: Insights Studio
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboarding, reporting, and market analysis to Spotify's sales teams.

data_flow: Advertiser campaigns enter Spotify through buying channels such as Ads Exchange and Ads Manager, where automated workflows speed launch and trafficking. Gen-AI-powered audio production tools help create scalable ad assets, while campaign and market data flows into Insights Studio so sales teams can report on performance and optimize how advertisers use Spotify's inventory.
business_outcome: Spotify scaled its ad operation into many more markets, shortened campaign-launch times, reduced trafficking effort, enabled advertisers to produce audio creative more easily, and improved internal visibility into ad performance and growth opportunities.
